subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should previously paired native operator tokens gain `operator.questions` through a controlled migration/re-pair flow, or should legacy devices intentionally remain unable to access questions until users reauthorize them?
rationale: The scope grants access to question records and resolution, so preserving feature access for existing users and preserving the authorization boundary cannot be decided mechanically.

options.title: Controlled reauthorization or migration
options.body: Add a bounded upgrade flow that obtains or replaces legacy operator credentials with the explicitly approved question scope before enabling native cards.

options.title: Require manual re-pairing
options.body: Keep stored token scopes unchanged and make the apps present a clear re-pair recovery path when question access is unavailable.

options.title: Defer native scope rollout
options.body: Split native question cards from this PR until maintainers choose and document the legacy-token policy.

recommendation.title: Controlled reauthorization or migration
recommendation.body: Add a bounded upgrade flow that obtains or replaces legacy operator credentials with the explicitly approved question scope before enabling native cards.

likelyOwner.reason: This branch and the preceding merged question-runtime work define the affected operator-scope and native-client behavior.
